what_changed: NCUA codifies the Fair Hiring in Banking Act and IRPS 19-1 on credit union participation by persons with certain criminal convictions, and rescinds IRPS 19-1.
rationale: Credit union employment and participation rule; the rescinded IRPS concerns hiring, not servicing conduct. Prefilter kept it only on 12 CFR 748 in its CFR list. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
